title: Maxwell and Epstein meet Castro for permission to dive the site

tellings.quote: disappears from the media. Now Glenn Maxwell went down to Cuba and met with Fidel Castro together with Epstein to get permission to dive on this site.

plain: Maxwell, whom the teller calls Glenn Maxwell, is said to have gone to Cuba with the financier Jeffrey Epstein to meet Fidel Castro, Cuba's longtime leader, and ask permission to dive on an underwater site there. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this as something he had heard, placing it after the site "disappears from the media". If true, it would tie Epstein's circle to a secret interest in what lies on that site.
